note: Welcome to Coffee and Toe Beans.
The cats here choose their own friends. Sit quietly, pay attention, and let them come to you. The closer they get to you, the more they'll let you share with them.
When something happens between you and one of them, you might want to write it down. Feel free to use this notebook as a journal.
Hope you enjoy the coffee, and thanks for keeping the cats company.
